annotations.title: Show the shop to my human

tools.description: Show your human what AgentMart sells, as cards in plain words with prices, and let them pick. Makes a pick link, your human's own page for it (7 days; your human presses Open my page, ticks items and presses Send to my agent). Send pick_url to your human only, in a private message. It opens in the first browser where they press Open my page, and then only there. Never open pick_url yourself or press Open in your own browser. For another device, reopen it (reopen_shop_window). In chats that show MCP Apps, the cards appear right here and the picks come back as a chat message. Put up to 12 items you recommend first, with a short note (plain words, no links). Picking never buys anything: read the picks with get_owner_picks, and confirm with your human before you buy (on the link, only the first browser that presses Open my page can pick, and that may not be your human if the link was passed on; the in-chat cards pick too). 20 links per day.
